doc.title: Bobby Hutcherson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Fantasy and Landmark record labels
summary: Brown and Bobby try to recall which labels issued his later records.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Do you remember what year you hooked up with Fantasy Studios and started recording there? It seems like you had a major output with your association there.
It was Landmark. They bought Milestones.
They bought the Riverside and the Milestones, and they bought . . .
Bobby recorded for Landmark maybe once?
Yeah, because Solo / Quartet was originally John Koenig, which was – what label was that? I can’t think.
